svg.aria-label: One hub-peering stack, applied from the Sydney path, creates both sides of TGW peering plus remote routes, the private zone and DHCP options in each Region
svg.font-family: Manrope, Open Sans, Segoe UI, sans-serif
svg.title: One hub-peering stack, both sides of the peer
svg.desc: The Terraform stack at environment/sandbox/ap-southeast-2/hub-peering creates a single TGW peering attachment that exists in both Regions, shown as a band spanning them. Under it, ap-southeast-2 Sydney is the requester and ap-southeast-6 Auckland is the accepter. Each Region gets the same three things: the peer associated to its no_inspection route table along with static routes to the other Region's spoke CIDRs, the lab.demo private zone associated to its spoke VPC with an A record, and a DHCP option set carrying the lab.demo search domain. There is no second apply in Auckland.
svg.text: one id, queried in both Regions
peer association + static routes to Akl:
peer association + static routes to Syd:
Peer sits on no_inspection in both Regions — passthrough mesh until Network Firewall is attached.
